shell_capture_completed_notice: Capture completed. Use Open captured CPU to verify and import the protobuf.
shell_raw_capture_completed_notice: Raw capture completed. A protobuf conversion is needed before CPU import.
shell_select_profiler_first: Select an imported profiler workspace first
shell_ai_generation_exhausted: AI generation counter exhausted; restart required
shell_settings_directory_unavailable: Settings persistence unavailable: no application data directory
settings_ai_approval_description: AI requests require frozen profiler evidence, explicit network approval and a one-shot credential. Credentials are never stored in settings.
settings_capture_confirmation_descriptio: Capture still requires explicit target inspection and confirmation. Cancellation and remote lifecycle status are shown separately.
settings_capture_defaults_description: Defaults used when opening the CPU capture planner. They do not start a device operation.
settings_description: Language and appearance preferences for the Rust desktop application.
settings_independent_preferences: Settings are Rust-owned and independent of the Compose application. Imported traces, symbols and user content remain unchanged.
settings_migration_description: Compose remains the behavior oracle while the Rust desktop rewrite is in progress.
settings_tool_paths_description: Tool paths are resolved explicitly by each Rust adapter. No legacy Compose preferences or environment credentials are imported.
shell_cpu_import_description: Select a SIMPLEPERF protobuf export. Raw perf.data requires a compatible Simpleperf protobuf converter. No device, source or cloud access occurs when importing.
shell_device_discovery_description: Device discovery is read-only; selecting a device does not authorize capture. PID alone is not a process-instance identity.
shell_migration_status: Migration in progress. Existing Compose remains the behavior oracle. Native GUI, parity, resource budgets and release qualification are pending.
shell_rust_gpui_kit_native_performance_w: Rust + GPUI Kit native performance workstation
shell_select_device_first: Select a device to list its processes
